name: input
title: Input
description: A single-line text field (@didact/ui, layers 1-2): a styled native <input> with no headless primitive behind it, reading @didact/theme's real tokens (border-input, text-muted-foreground placeholder, the shared focus-ring and aria-invalid treatment). Pair it with the label item via htmlFor/id -- see packages/ui/src/components/input.tsx.
